# FERRY error reference

Every error response carries a machine-readable `code` from this table. Match on
the `code`, never on the message or the HTTP status: statuses are shared between
unrelated conditions, and messages are prose that may be reworded.

`Retry identical` answers one question only — **could sending the byte-identical
request again ever succeed?** It is a property of the request, not a suggestion
about patience.

- **yes** — resend the same request, with the same `Idempotency-Key`, after a backoff.
- **no** — the same request will never succeed. Some of these are still safe to
  retry *as a new request with a new `Idempotency-Key`*; the message says so when
  that is true. If it does not say so, do not resend.

For money movement the distinction matters more than anywhere else, so read
[the transfer decision table](AGENTS.md#what-to-do-with-every-answer) before
acting on any failure from `POST /v1/transfers`.

| Code | HTTP | Retry identical | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TOKEN_MISSING` | 401 | no | Authenticate with a bearer token in the Authorization header. |
| `TOKEN_INVALID` | 401 | no | The bearer token is not valid. |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | 401 | no | The bearer token has expired. Issue a new one. |
| `TOKEN_REVOKED` | 401 | no | The bearer token has been revoked. |
| `ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED` | 401 | no | This organization is suspended. |
| `ENVIRONMENT_DISABLED` | 401 | no | This environment is disabled. |
| `WRONG_TOKEN_CLASS` | 403 | no | This endpoint does not accept this kind of credential. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | 403 | no | This token lacks a scope this operation requires. |
| `ROLE_FORBIDDEN` | 403 | no | This member's role may not perform this operation. |
| `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` | 403 | no | This operation requires step-up authentication. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | no | This operation is not permitted. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no | No such resource. |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | no | The request is not valid. |
| `MALFORMED_JSON` | 400 | no | The request body is not valid JSON. |
| `CURSOR_INVALID` | 400 | no | The cursor was not issued by this API. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | 415 | no | Send the request body as application/json. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes | Too many requests. Retry after the interval in the Retry-After header. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | yes | Something went wrong on our side. Quote the request id if you report this. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | yes | A dependency this operation needs is unavailable. Retry after the interval in the Retry-After header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | 400 | no | Send an Idempotency-Key header with this request. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID` | 400 | no | The Idempotency-Key header is not a valid key. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 409 | no | This Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS` | 409 | yes | This Idempotency-Key names a command that is still running. Poll it or retry after the interval. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_EXPIRED` | 409 | no | The stored answer for this Idempotency-Key has expired. The key is never re-executed; use a new one. |
| `COMMAND_UNRESOLVED` | 409 | no | This command could not be resolved automatically and is with an operator. |
| `UPSTREAM_BUSY` | 503 | yes | The upstream service could not be reached. Retry after the interval in the Retry-After header. |
| `UPSTREAM_NOT_CONFIGURED` | 503 | no | This operation is not available in this deployment. |
| `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | no | The request never reached the upstream service. Nothing was executed; retry with a new Idempotency-Key. |
| `UPSTREAM_CONTRACT_VIOLATION` | 502 | no | The upstream service answered with something this API cannot act on. |
| `UPSTREAM_CREDENTIALS_INVALID` | 503 | no | This deployment's upstream credential was refused. An operator must re-attach it with the ferry:oms:credentials:set task. |
| `UPSTREAM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | yes | The upstream service could not be authenticated against. Retry after the interval in the Retry-After header. |
| `PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no | No such plan. |
| `PLAN_EXPIRED` | 410 | no | This plan has expired. Simulate again for a new one. |
| `PLAN_ALREADY_USED` | 409 | no | This plan has already been used. A plan is single-use. |
| `PLAN_CHANGED` | 409 | no | The quote behind this plan has changed. Simulate again. |
| `PLAN_KEY_MISMATCH` | 403 | no | This plan was not issued to this credential. |
| `POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED` | 403 | no | This environment has no spend policy, so no money may move. |
| `POLICY_INVALID` | 403 | no | This credential's spend policy cannot be read, so no money may move. |
| `POLICY_UNPRICED_ASSET` | 403 | no | This asset has no USD basis, so it cannot be counted against a spend policy. |
| `POLICY_CUSTOMER_NOT_ALLOWED` | 403 | no | This credential may not move money for this customer. |
| `POLICY_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED` | 403 | no | This credential may not move money to this destination. |
| `DESTINATION_TOO_NEW` | 403 | no | This destination is not usable yet. Wait for the delay this environment's policy requires, then simulate again — the plan behind the refused request is spent. |
| `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_TRANSACTION` | 403 | no | This transfer is over the per-transaction limit. |
| `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_DAY` | 403 | no | This transfer is over the daily amount limit. |
| `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_30D` | 403 | no | This transfer is over the 30-day amount limit. |
| `POLICY_MAX_TRANSACTIONS_PER_DAY` | 403 | no | This transfer is over the daily transaction-count limit. |
| `EXECUTION_SUSPENDED` | 403 | no | Execution is suspended for this environment. |
| `CORRIDOR_UNSUPPORTED` | 422 | no | This API does not quote transfers between these two instrument types. |
| `CORRIDOR_NOT_EXECUTABLE` | 422 | no | This corridor is published but cannot be executed. See details.reason. |
| `DESTINATION_NOT_EXECUTABLE` | 422 | no | This destination cannot be executed against. See details.reason. |
| `INSTRUMENT_INVALID` | 422 | no | An instrument field is outside the vocabulary this arm admits. |
| `AMOUNT_INVALID` | 422 | no | The amount block is not one this corridor can be quoted on. |
| `QUOTE_REJECTED` | 422 | no | The upstream service refused to quote this transfer. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN` | 404 | no | No webhook endpoint is registered at this address. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_RETIRED` | 410 | no | This webhook endpoint no longer accepts deliveries. |
| `WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID` | 401 | no | The delivery signature did not verify. |
| `WEBHOOK_MODE_MISMATCH` | 403 | no | This webhook endpoint's mode does not match the environment it resolves to. |
| `WEBHOOK_BODY_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no | The delivery body is larger than this endpoint accepts. |
| `WEBHOOK_INGRESS_UNVERIFIED` | 503 | yes | This deployment has not verified the webhook delivery contract, so deliveries are refused. |

## By status

- **400** — `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `MALFORMED_JSON`, `CURSOR_INVALID`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID`
- **401** — `TOKEN_MISSING`, `TOKEN_INVALID`, `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, `TOKEN_REVOKED`, `ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED`, `ENVIRONMENT_DISABLED`, `WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID`
- **403** — `WRONG_TOKEN_CLASS`, `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`, `ROLE_FORBIDDEN`, `STEP_UP_REQUIRED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `PLAN_KEY_MISMATCH`, `POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `POLICY_INVALID`, `POLICY_UNPRICED_ASSET`, `POLICY_CUSTOMER_NOT_ALLOWED`, `POLICY_DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED`, `DESTINATION_TOO_NEW`, `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_TRANSACTION`, `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_DAY`, `POLICY_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_30D`, `POLICY_MAX_TRANSACTIONS_PER_DAY`, `EXECUTION_SUSPENDED`, `WEBHOOK_MODE_MISMATCH`
- **404** — `NOT_FOUND`, `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN`
- **409** — `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_EXPIRED`, `COMMAND_UNRESOLVED`, `PLAN_ALREADY_USED`, `PLAN_CHANGED`
- **410** — `PLAN_EXPIRED`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_RETIRED`
- **413** — `WEBHOOK_BODY_TOO_LARGE`
- **415** — `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`
- **422** — `CORRIDOR_UNSUPPORTED`, `CORRIDOR_NOT_EXECUTABLE`, `DESTINATION_NOT_EXECUTABLE`, `INSTRUMENT_INVALID`, `AMOUNT_INVALID`, `QUOTE_REJECTED`
- **429** — `RATE_LIMITED`
- **500** — `INTERNAL_ERROR`
- **502** — `UPSTREAM_CONTRACT_VIOLATION`
- **503** — `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `UPSTREAM_BUSY`, `UPSTREAM_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, `UPSTREAM_CREDENTIALS_INVALID`, `UPSTREAM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE`, `WEBHOOK_INGRESS_UNVERIFIED`

## Codes you will not see

Catalogued but not emitted anywhere in `app/` or `lib/`. Do not write a
branch for these; if one ever arrives, it is a bug in FERRY.

- `UPSTREAM_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE`
- `UPSTREAM_CREDENTIALS_INVALID`

One further code is emitted in principle but unreachable in practice:

- `DESTINATION_TOO_NEW` — no caller supplies `destination_usable_after`; it awaits the destination mirror.

This list is not a claim that every *other* code is reachable. It is
derived by looking for each code as a literal, which finds a code with
no emitter at all but cannot find one whose emitter is never called.
